sources.title: RFC 9334: Remote ATtestation procedureS Architecture
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Open DICE：分層量測變更的相依閉包
related.titleEn: Open DICE: dependency closure after layered measurement changes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：90與40秒可重算，錯受眾及舊政策均有獨立拒絕理由；沒有把有效簽章等同裝置目前安全。 交付rats-flow.csv、政策版本矩陣與時序圖；所有裝置識別與量測值都是合成教學材料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 90 and 40 seconds with independent rejection reasons for audience and policy mismatch. A valid signature is not reported as proof that a device is currently safe. Deliver rats-flow.csv, the policy-revision matrix and an event timeline. Device identifiers and measurement values are synthetic teaching data, not claims about an attested production platform.
related.difference: 建立八層單一路徑L0至L7，記錄每層程式、設定、模式及前層輸入識別；用相依邊解釋為何上層變更可能影響下游派生結果。
related.differenceEn: Build an eight-layer path L0 through L7 with code, configuration, mode and predecessor identifiers. Use dependency edges to explain why an upstream input change can affect downstream derivations rather than treating layer hashes as unrelated inventory fields.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課允許證據最長300秒，結果最長120秒；服務可用餘裕取兩項剩餘值最小者。這是本地依賴方政策，RATS架構不替所有部署指定這些秒數。 觀測時證據年齡180秒、結果年齡30秒，政策版本與受眾皆相符；保持四個時間來源可追溯而非混用本機檔案mtime。 餘裕min(300−180,120−30)=90秒；證據年齡增至260秒而結果年齡不變時，餘裕變40秒。
本課採簡化模型：改變第k層後，該層及所有後繼均需重新計算，共8−k層；此模型不宣稱涵蓋真實DICE全部憑證與金鑰生命周期。 八層中修改L2，所有測試派生值用公開字串與SHA-256佔位運算；L0與L1輸入固定，沒有任何硬體根秘密。 需重算8−2=6層；改為只修改L5時需重算8−5=3層。兩個情境是獨立變更，不可把六與三相加當單次影響。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy permits evidence age up to 300 seconds and result age up to 120. Usable margin is the smaller remainder. These are relying-party choices; the RATS architecture does not mandate these durations for every deployment. At observation, evidence age is 180 seconds and result age is 30, with matching policy revision and audience. Keep the time sources traceable instead of substituting local file modification times for authenticated claims. Margin is min(300−180, 120−30)=90 seconds. Increasing evidence age to 260 while keeping result age fixed leaves 40 seconds, revealing the evidence limit as the new bottleneck.

In the simplified model, changing layer k requires recomputation of that layer and every successor, totaling 8−k layers. This dependency exercise does not claim to implement all certificate, key-lifecycle or sealing details of a real DICE platform. Modify L2 in an eight-layer chain. Derivation placeholders use public strings and SHA-256, with L0 and L1 inputs fixed and no hardware root secret. Label these hashes as dependency demonstrations rather than valid device identities. Recompute 8−2=6 layers. In a separate scenario changing only L5 requires 8−5=3. These are independent edits, so adding six and three would misrepresent the impact of either single change.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Keycloak UMA：資源範圍與決策策略交集
related.titleEn: Keycloak UMA: resource scopes and decision-strategy intersections
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：90與40秒可重算，錯受眾及舊政策均有獨立拒絕理由；沒有把有效簽章等同裝置目前安全。 交付rats-flow.csv、政策版本矩陣與時序圖；所有裝置識別與量測值都是合成教學材料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 90 and 40 seconds with independent rejection reasons for audience and policy mismatch. A valid signature is not reported as proof that a device is currently safe. Deliver rats-flow.csv, the policy-revision matrix and an event timeline. Device identifiers and measurement values are synthetic teaching data, not claims about an attested production platform.
related.difference: 建立12筆資源/scope請求，列出角色政策與資源所有權政策的各自結果；固定策略與資源伺服器，不將不同realm資料混算。
related.differenceEn: Build 12 resource/scope requests with separate role-policy and resource-ownership outcomes. Pin decision strategy and resource server, avoiding the accidental aggregation of permissions from different realms or unrelated resource definitions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課允許證據最長300秒，結果最長120秒；服務可用餘裕取兩項剩餘值最小者。這是本地依賴方政策，RATS架構不替所有部署指定這些秒數。 觀測時證據年齡180秒、結果年齡30秒，政策版本與受眾皆相符；保持四個時間來源可追溯而非混用本機檔案mtime。 餘裕min(300−180,120−30)=90秒；證據年齡增至260秒而結果年齡不變時，餘裕變40秒。
本課指定兩政策皆正面才授權；計數必須取逐列交集，不能把兩政策各自允許數相加。實際部署還需核對permission層與聚合policy各自策略。 12筆中角色政策通過9筆，所有權通過8筆，兩者共同通過6筆；資料表明列共同與單側通過者。 Unanimous通過率6/12×100=50%；補正兩筆已有角色資格者的所有權資料後，交集變8，比例66.667%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy permits evidence age up to 300 seconds and result age up to 120. Usable margin is the smaller remainder. These are relying-party choices; the RATS architecture does not mandate these durations for every deployment. At observation, evidence age is 180 seconds and result age is 30, with matching policy revision and audience. Keep the time sources traceable instead of substituting local file modification times for authenticated claims. Margin is min(300−180, 120−30)=90 seconds. Increasing evidence age to 260 while keeping result age fixed leaves 40 seconds, revealing the evidence limit as the new bottleneck.

The exercise requires both policies to evaluate positively. Count the row-level intersection rather than adding independent allow totals. A deployment must also verify strategy settings at the permission and aggregated-policy levels, which are distinct configuration locations. Among 12 requests the role policy passes nine, ownership passes eight and six pass both. List joint and one-sided outcomes explicitly so the intersection is inspectable and not inferred from marginal totals alone. Unanimous admission is 6/12×100=50 percent. Correcting ownership for two already role-qualified requests increases the intersection to eight, or approximately 66.667 percent, without changing the request population.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
